immortalForges.beFirst: Be the first to claim the title!

leaderboard.introDescription: Every workout is a battle for glory. Compete across the Immortal Forges, conquer the leaderboards, and rise to become Daizōshō.
leaderboard.factionDescription: Each faction measures a different aspect of performance: Strength, Running, or Flexibility.
leaderboard.forgesDescription: Each Forge measures a different skill. Top one to become its Champion — dominate all of them to become Daizōshō.
leaderboard.daizoshoDescription: The faction's highest honor — earned for balanced excellence across every Forge, not just one.
leaderboard.strengthDescription: Peak performance — based on your strongest lifts and bodyweight feats.
leaderboard.runningDescription: Greatest endurance — longest distance completed, with faster times breaking ties.
leaderboard.flexibilityDescription: Your best mobility and end-range strength across key standards.
leaderboard.burdenDescription: Total workload this cycle — weight lifted, distance run, time under tension.
leaderboard.judgementDescription: Efficiency per bodyweight — rewards output relative to size, not raw numbers.
leaderboard.strifeDescription: Total XP this cycle — from workouts, quests, milestones, and streaks.

factionWars.introDescription: A weekly clash between all three factions. Victory goes to teamwork and consistency — not headcount.
factionWars.battleModeDescription: Switch between the current fight and all-time results to see who’s winning now — and who’s leading overall.
factionWars.scoringDescription: Score = total faction XP ÷ active members. Highest average XP per member wins the week.
factionWars.victoryPointsDescription: Win a week, earn 1 Victory Point. First to 3 Victory Points becomes Monthly Champion.
factionWars.monthlyRewardsDescription: Monthly Champions earn a 7-day +5% XP boost.

plateOfKeragura.introDescription: Every level unlocks a new Plate of Keragura, revealing lore, heroes, and history of the world.
plateOfKeragura.unlockedPlateDescription: Tap any unlocked Plate to reveal its artwork and story. Once loaded, you can expand or collapse it anytime.
plateOfKeragura.lockedPlateDescription: Locked Plates become available as you level up. Tap one to see the level required.

forgeAttributes.introDescription: Forge Attributes track different paths of growth — improvement, effort, mastery, volume, and consistency.
forgeAttributes.koboDescription: Personal improvement — earn XP by setting new personal bests.
forgeAttributes.kozuchiDescription: Workout effort — earn XP by training more and outperforming past sessions.
forgeAttributes.wazaDescription: Discipline mastery — progress through strength, endurance, and flexibility milestones.
forgeAttributes.shogenTandaDescription: Lifetime training volume — grows with every rep, mile, and minute trained.
forgeAttributes.tagaDescription: Consistency — build streaks to unlock greater rewards.
forgeAttributes.badgesDescription: Badges track specific achievements across Strength, Running, and Flexibility. Click to open any badge to see what it measures, or explore them all in the full list.

mainPage.characterEvolutionDescription: Your character card evolves with every new rank you reach.
mainPage.rankAscensionDescription: Unlock all 10 badges in a tier to rank up and evolve your card.
mainPage.levelAndLegacyDescription: Levels raise your leaderboard position and unlock new Plates of Keragura.
